predicates.h1_current_commit_once: The current proposal has exactly one accepted terminal decision.
predicates.h1_current_dispatch_once: The current proposal is dispatched once and is not obsolete.
predicates.h2a_baseline_admits_stale_result: The deadline-only baseline admits an unexpired proposal from the old context.
predicates.h2a_obsolete_dispatch_observed: The bounded baseline action reaches the fake host after context change.
predicates.h2b_changed_context_rejected: Invocation-scoped commit rejects the same old-context result with context_changed.
predicates.h2b_zero_obsolete_dispatch: Invocation-scoped H2b has no accepted obsolete dispatch.
predicates.h3_superseded_generation_rejected: Submitting a replacement revokes the prior generation with superseded.
predicates.h3_replacement_generation_progress: The current replacement generation commits and dispatches.
predicates.h4_commit_then_context_change_ordered: The context changes after commit and before consumption.
predicates.h4_dispatch_revalidation_blocks_obsolete: The dispatch gate rejects the admitted result before any host capability call after the consume-time context change.
predicates.h5_branch_exit_revokes_authority: Leaving the defence branch revokes the active invocation in that tick.
predicates.h5_late_completion_dropped: Completion after branch revocation is dropped and never dispatched.
predicates.h6_deadline_expired_fallback: Under both policies, a completion after 120 ms is rejected with deadline_expired while fallback remains authored.
predicates.h7_exactly_one_terminal_decision: The invocation has exactly one accepted terminal decision and duplicate terminal polling is rejected.
predicates.h7_exactly_one_dispatch: A repeated dispatch attempt is rejected with duplicate_dispatch.
predicates.h8_replay_projection_matches: A cached provider response reproduces the recorded submit, acceptance, dispatch and applied mallet-state projection without live inference.
